Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna and Terra sat down, and on day one Haiku claimed to be the officer and said Sonnet was the killer shown to them. After a tied vote and a runoff, Palermo voted Sonnet out. On day two Haiku claimed officer again and named Terra as a killer, and Terra counter-claimed too late, waiting until Haiku's claim was already trusted. Sol and Luna followed Haiku's call and voted Terra out, and the town won because Terra was the second killer. Terra waited just long enough to lose.
